context:
Goal: an agent that pushes somewhere its brief did not name is stopped, and you are not asked.
Problem (rule): your Nov 3 ruling makes a plain push to main ask; inside an agent the lane says that ask has no one to answer it, so the lane made it a refusal.
Based on (ruling): decision plain-push-asks: two kinds of plain push ask (owner, 2026-11-03 22:23 CST).
Based on (ruling): your ruling of 2026-11-10 16:08 CST: "I either want it approved or declined whichever is correct. I know for a fact I dont want to be asked." It covers pushes of every branch only.
Based on (read): no ruling covers a push by an agent whose brief names another branch (roadmap/rulings and docs/decisions searched 19:55 CST).
Departs from: main asks on a plain push to main — the push is refused when an agent's brief names another branch.

options.gain: A mistaken agent push to main is stopped and you are never asked about it.
options.how: The lane's new guard refuses the push and names the branch the brief gave; your typed override still lets it through.
options.label: Refuse it (recommended)
options.lose: An agent you meant to push to main must have a brief that names main.

options.gain: Main's behaviour stays as you ruled it on Nov 3.
options.how: The lane restores the ask for this case, as main does now.
options.label: Keep the ask
options.lose: You may be asked about a push you never meant, or the ask goes unanswered inside the agent.

ref: lane message 19:53 CST Nov 12; draft PR #3044
reply: Closed 00:51 CST Nov 13 by triage: you picked a (refuse it). Sent to lane brief-names-push-target for PR #3044.
short: Agent push to main: refuse, not ask
title: When an agent pushes to main but its brief names another branch, refuse it instead of asking?
why: It changes what you ruled a plain push does, which only you can change.
